d: Short ash-brown hair with choppy layers and bangs framing the face, paired with golden-brown eyes and a neutral expression. The figure appears as a young adolescent with a petite build. The outfit consists of a white and dark-gray cropped sleeveless top with magenta accents, a dark-gray pleated mini-skirt, and a single white glove on the right hand. Signature details include a gray mechanical headset with a small antenna and large, heavy gray metallic armor plating with integrated cannons and a hanging chain attached to the waist.
